newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Vanik in bonus announcement.
newsitem.headline: Vanik in bonus announcement.

text.p: Vanik Incorporation Ltd announced a bonus issue of one new share for every four held on Friday.
"In addition to the bonus, the company is also issuing one warrant for every four shares held," a company spokesman said.
The warrant holder can buy one Vanik share at 25 rupees three years from the date of issue, he said.
Investment bank Vanik's existing issued capital of 44.87 million 10-rupee shares will rise by 11.2 million shares to 56.07 million, after the bonus issue.
"The issued capital will rise by a further 11.2 million shares to 67.27 million when warrant holders exercise their rights," the spokesman said. --- Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
